metadata.title: TEMPO AU26 V2 Stimulator - Compact Prototyping Perfboard

boardDimensions.compatibleBlank: Standard 4x6 cm or 5x7 cm single/double-sided perfboard

usability.arduinoUnoR4: Separate 1x3 female header for Power/Analog (5V, GND, A0) on the left edge and 1x6 female header for Digital (D2-D7) on the top edge perfectly mirror the physical pin clusters on the Uno R4.
usability.plateLayout: The 8 output channels are arranged in strictly sequential order (Row A / Well 1 down to Row H / Well 8) on a 1x8 female header at Column 18.
usability.oneHoleGap: Column 19 is an intentional 1-hole empty gap separating the Well signal header (Col 18) and the Ground return header (Col 20). This prevents accidental shorts when inserting jumper pins, accommodates standard 0.2 inch / 5.08 mm 2-pin keyed electrode plugs, and allows clipping miniature oscilloscope ground probes without bridging live signal pins.

circuitProtectionAndPassives.decouplingCapacitors: Three 0.1 uF ceramic capacitors (C1, C2, C3) placed directly adjacent to the power pins of U1 (OPA340), U2 (74HC4053), and U3 (74HC4051) to eliminate switching transients, prevent op-amp oscillation, and ensure rail stability during high-speed pacing edges. One 10 uF bulk capacitor (C4) at the power entry rail dampens supply dips.
circuitProtectionAndPassives.outputCurrentLimiting: R1 (100 Ohm, 1/4W) is placed in series between U2 switch common (Pin 14) and U3 multiplexer input (Pin 3). It bridges the physical 2-hole gap between the two DIP-16 chips on Row 7. In physiological media, electrode probes can accidentally bridge; R1 limits maximum fault current to ~6 mA at 1V, protecting both the OPA340 buffer and the 74HC switches while introducing negligible voltage drop into biological cell loads.
circuitProtectionAndPassives.failSafeResistors: R2 (100 kOhm pull-down on D2) ensures U2 defaults to 0V resting discharge if the control line is disconnected or during MCU boot. R3 and R4 (100 kOhm pull-ups on D3 and D4 active-high disable pins) hold U2 isolated and U3 multiplexer disabled if jumper cables are unplugged. R5 (100 kOhm bleeder to GND) prevents charge accumulation on electrodes when isolated.

manufacturingAndSoldering.ironClearance: Every IC socket has at least 1-2 empty holes of clearance on all sides, allowing easy manual soldering without risking heat damage to neighboring plastic sockets.
manufacturingAndSoldering.railArchitecture: Continuous 5V rail along Row 3 and continuous GND bus along Row 14. All chip supply and ground pins tap directly into these rails.
manufacturingAndSoldering.u2_to_u3_bridge: U2 Pin 14 and U3 Pin 3 sit on Row 7 separated by 2 holes, exactly spanned by protection resistor R1 with zero wire clutter.

billOfMaterials.desc: Rail-to-rail precision CMOS op-amp (unity-gain DAC buffer)
High-speed CMOS triple 2-channel analog switch (pulse / resting discharge selector)
High-speed CMOS 8-channel analog multiplexer (96-well column A-H selector)

billOfMaterials.package: Ceramic disc / MLCC (0.1 in / 2.54 mm pitch)
billOfMaterials.desc: High-frequency power supply decoupling bypass capacitors (one per IC)
Bulk power rail reservoir capacitor at 5V/GND entry
Series output short-circuit protection resistor (between U2.14 and U3.3)
Safety pull-down on D2 (forces default resting discharge 0V if disconnected)
Safety pull-up on D3 / Disable (forces default isolation if disconnected)
Safety pull-up on D4 / MUX Disable (forces default open-circuit if disconnected)
Output bleed resistor from MUX COM to GND (prevents static charge build-up when isolated)
Arduino Power & Analog In: Pin 1 (+5V), Pin 2 (GND), Pin 3 (DAC A0)
Arduino Digital Controls: Pin 1 (D2), Pin 2 (D3), Pin 3 (D4), Pin 4 (D5), Pin 5 (D6), Pin 6 (D7)
Ground Return Bus Pins (separated from J_OUT_WELL by 1 empty hole column)

components.desc: OPA340 (Notch UP, Rows 7-10). Pin 1 top-left (3,7), Pin 4 bot-left (3,10), Pin 5 bot-right (5,10), Pin 8 top-right (5,7)
CD74HC4053 (Notch UP, Rows 5-12). Pin 1 top-left (7,5), Pin 8 bot-left (7,12), Pin 9 bot-right (9,12), Pin 16 top-right (9,5)
CD74HC4051 (Notch UP, Rows 5-12). Pin 1 top-left (12,5), Pin 8 bot-left (12,12), Pin 9 bot-right (14,12), Pin 16 top-right (14,5)
Decoupling capacitor for U1 (OPA340), adjacent to Pin 7
Decoupling capacitor for U2 (74HC4053), adjacent to Pin 16
Decoupling capacitor for U3 (74HC4051), adjacent to Pin 16
Bulk reservoir capacitor at power entry
Series protection resistor directly spanning the 2-hole gap between U2 Pin 14 and U3 Pin 3 on Row 7
Safety pull-down on D2 (Select) to GND rail
Safety pull-up on D3 (Disable) to 5V rail
Safety pull-up on D4 (Mux Disable) to 5V rail
Bleed resistor from MUX COM to GND rail
Exact 1-hole clearance gap between Well signal outputs and Ground returns

stepByStepAssemblyGuide: Step 1: Sockets and Headers. Insert DIP sockets (U1 DIP-8, U2 DIP-16, U3 DIP-16) and female pin headers (J_PWR 1x3, J_DIG 1x6, J_OUT_WELL 1x8, J_OUT_GND 1x8). Verify Col 19 is left completely empty as the 1-hole gap between J_OUT_WELL (Col 18) and J_OUT_GND (Col 20). Solder corner pins to anchor them.
Step 2: Power and Ground Rails. Lay a bare tinned copper bus wire along Row 3 for +5V and along Row 14 for GND. Connect J_PWR Pin 1 (Row 7) to Row 3, and J_PWR Pin 2 (Row 8) to Row 14.

Step 3: Decoupling and Reservoir Capacitors. Solder C1 (0.1 uF) between U1 Pin 7 and GND. Solder C2 (0.1 uF) between U2 Pin 16 and GND. Solder C3 (0.1 uF) between U3 Pin 16 and GND. Place bulk electrolytic C4 (10 uF) across 5V and GND at Col 2.

Step 4: Resistors. Solder R1 (100 Ohm) spanning directly across Row 7 between U2 Pin 14 (Col 9) and U3 Pin 3 (Col 12). Solder R2 (100k pull-down on D2), R3 (100k pull-up on D3), R4 (100k pull-up on D4), and R5 (100k bleeder).
Step 5: Tie Unused & Static Pins to Ground. Solder-bridge U2 Pins 7, 8, 9, 10, 12 to the GND net. Solder-bridge U3 Pins 7 and 8 to GND.

Step 6: Control & Signal Wiring. Route insulated 30 AWG kynar / wrapping wire from J_PWR Pin 3 to U1 Pin 3 (DAC A0); bridge U1 Pin 6 to Pin 2 and U2 Pin 13 (Op-amp buffer output); connect J_DIG Pins 1-6 to D2-D7 inputs on U2 and U3.
Step 7: Multiplexer Output Routing. Route the 8 channel pins from U3 to J_OUT_WELL Pins 1 through 8 in sequential order (Wells 1 to 8 / Rows A to H).
Step 8: Output Ground Bus. Solder a continuous vertical bridge down J_OUT_GND Pins 1 through 8 (Col 20, Rows 5-12) and link it directly to the bottom GND rail on Row 14.
